cv.text: Profile

cv.heading: NORMAL
cv.text: Senior 3D Generalist with over 15 years of experience specializing in photorealistic architectural visualization, product rendering, and manufacture-ready CAD design. Proven expertise in building end-to-end rendering pipelines from scratch, managing full project lifecycles spanning complex 3D modeling, lighting, look development, and final compositing. Highly skilled in optimizing rendering workflows, utilizing Python scripting for procedural geometry, and automating mesh operations. Successfully delivered over 150 commercial projects, encompassing high-fidelity VFX, motion design, and precision CAD modeling tailored for advanced additive manufacturing and functional mechanical assemblies. Adept at translating complex technical requirements into compelling visual narratives and production-ready assets.
